Interface NvmlQuery.NvmlScope<H>

Type Parameters:
H - the backend's device handle type: a JNA Pointer, or an FFM handle bundled with the arena its out-parameters are allocated from
Enclosing class:
NvmlQuery
public static interface NvmlQuery.NvmlScope<H>
A backend's NVML lifecycle and device-handle acquisition, implemented once per binding.

  • Method Details

    • init

      boolean init()
      Calls nvmlInit_v2, incrementing NVML's internal reference count.
      Returns:
      true if NVML was initialized, in which case uninit() must be called exactly once

    • uninit

      void uninit()
      Calls nvmlShutdown, decrementing the reference count init() incremented.

    • withDevice

      <R> R withDevice(String deviceId, Function<H,R> body, R sentinel)
      Acquires a device handle matching the given identifier and applies body to it. Must be called while NVML is initialized. Any scope the handle depends on, such as an FFM arena, is opened and closed around body by the implementation, so no native resource escapes the backend.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the reader's result type
      Parameters:
      deviceId - the stable device identifier to match
      body - the reader to apply to the acquired handle
      sentinel - the value to return if no matching device could be acquired
      Returns:
      the reader's result, or sentinel if no device matched
